faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

questions.question: How long does it take to create a complete website?
questions.answer: It depends on the project. A showcase website can be delivered in 2-3 weeks, while a more complex site with databases or dynamic features typically takes 4-8 weeks.

questions.question: Will the website be optimized for Google (SEO)?
questions.answer: Absolutely. Every project is delivered with a clean semantic structure, compressed images, and ultra-fast performance to maximize your organic visibility from launch.

questions.question: Can I edit my content myself?
questions.answer: I offer this option for complex sites that require regular content management. In that case, I develop a custom dashboard. For showcase sites, I handle updates to ensure design and performance integrity.

questions.question: Why choose a freelancer over an agency?
questions.answer: Proximity and responsiveness. You have a single point of contact who knows your project inside out. No agency overhead costs — you only pay for expertise and production.

questions.question: Do I fully own the website after delivery?
questions.answer: Yes, you own 100% of your domain name, hosting, and source code. I provide all access credentials at launch.
